title: One orthogonal step, then another: two-angle addressing and the Berry phase
title_zh: 正交一次、正交两次：两角寻址与贝里相位
summary: From the north pole a single kind of turn only draws one circle; two orthogonal steps reach every point: tilt by θ about e₂, so the height becomes cos θ, then twist by φ about e₃ along that latitude, r(θ, φ) = (sin θ cos φ, sin θ sin φ, cos θ), with θ = 60°, φ = 45° landing on (√6/4, √6/4, 1/2), while at the poles the twist does nothing. Two axes only 30° apart still reach a target 110° from N in four turns of a greedy word; Lean checks that any rotation is a finite word in two non-collinear axes. Swapping the order of two quarter turns ends on +X or on −Y, 90° apart, and in each second step the point stays while its carried arrow turns a quarter. Around the octant loop N → +X → +Y → N the parallel-transported arrow comes back turned by the enclosed area Ω = π/2, and the literature gives the Berry phase −Ω/2 = −π/4. The same angle sits in the pairwise overlaps: Lean checks the latitude overlap (1 + i)/2 between +X and +Y, the three-point product Δ = (1 + i)/4 has phase π/4, and it does not move when each state is re-phased.
summary_zh: 从北极出发，只转一种只画得出一个圆；正交两步就走遍整颗球：先绕 e₂ 倾转 θ，高度变为 cos θ，再绕 e₃ 沿这条纬度圈拧转 φ，r(θ, φ) = (sin θ cos φ, sin θ sin φ, cos θ)；θ = 60°、φ = 45° 落在 (√6/4, √6/4, 1/2)，而在两极第二步白拧。两根只差 30° 的轴，按一条贪心规则交替转四次，照样到达离 N 为 110° 的目标；Lean 检验了任一旋转都是两根不共线轴的有限旋转字。两次 90° 转动换个次序，分别停在 +X 与 −Y，相隔 90°；第二步里点不动，它带着的箭头却转了四分之一圈。沿八分球回路 N → +X → +Y → N 平行搬运，箭头回来时转过所圈面积 Ω = π/2，文献给出贝里相位 −Ω/2 = −π/4。同一个角写在两两内积里：Lean 检验了同纬度内积公式，+X 与 +Y 的内积为 (1 + i)/2，三点连乘 Δ = (1 + i)/4 的相位为 π/4，给每个态乘上任意局部相位时它纹丝不动。
